scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings --max-diagnostics=none . && dependency-cruiser --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs apps packages tests && sherif && turbo boundaries
scripts.precommit: biome check --error-on-warnings --no-errors-on-unmatched --staged . && gitleaks git --pre-commit --staged --config .gitleaks.toml --redact --no-banner --exit-code 1 && turbo typecheck --filter='...[HEAD]'
scripts.check: all=$(git diff --name-only origin/main; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard); [ -n "$all" ] || { echo 'check: nothing differs from origin/main'; exit 0; }; f=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d origin/main; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard); { [ -z "$f" ] || biome check --error-on-warnings --no-errors-on-unmatched --files-ignore-unknown=true $f; } && turbo typecheck --filter='...[origin/main]' && t=$(printf '%s\n' $f | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|mts)$' || true) && { if [ -z "$t" ]; then echo 'check: no changed .ts file, so no unit test ran here; check:all runs every test'; else vitest related --run --passWithNoTests $t; fi; }
scripts.check:all: turbo build && pnpm lint && turbo typecheck && pnpm check:dupes && pnpm check:openapi && pnpm check:catalogs && pnpm test:unit && turbo test
scripts.check:catalogs: c() { find packages/i18n/src/locales -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 git hash-object; }; before=$(c); pnpm --filter @heliogrid/i18n extract >/dev/null; if [ "$before" = "$(c)" ]; then echo "catalogs OK - extraction produced no change"; else echo "catalogs STALE - this check re-ran extract, so the tree now holds the fresh catalogs; commit them:"; git diff --stat packages/i18n/src/locales; exit 1; fi
scripts.check:openapi: s=packages/contracts/openapi/openapi.json; before=$(git hash-object $s 2>/dev/null); pnpm --filter @heliogrid/contracts build && pnpm --filter @heliogrid/contracts openapi && if [ "$before" = "$(git hash-object $s)" ]; then echo 'openapi OK - the spec matches what the contract emits'; else echo 'openapi STALE - the fresh spec is now on disk; commit it with the contract change:'; git diff --stat $s; exit 1; fi
scripts.infra:up: bash -c '[ -f infra/temporal/pki/jwt/jwks.json ] || bash infra/temporal/scripts/make-dev-pki.sh' && docker compose -f infra/compose.yaml up -d && bash infra/temporal/scripts/bootstrap.sh && pnpm infra:token
